localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 施法器资源已调整：安装整根法杖或大型法杖，使用其真实魔力与核心升级；由附近中继器充能。
localized.en_us: Autocasters use an entire wand or staff, drawing its stored vis and applying its focus upgrades. Nearby relays recharge it.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 施法器新增电力魔法工具联动：电球每发消耗独立电池槽中的5120 EU。
localized.en_us: Autocasters support Electro-Magic Tools energy balls, spending 5,120 EU per shot from the separate battery slot.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 施法器配方适配四代：用缸中之脑替代五代的僵尸之脑。
localized.en_us: The Autocaster recipe uses TC4’s Brain in a Jar in place of TC5’s Zombie Brain.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 魔力碎片核心新增生存路线：完成震击后的研究即可制作，接入四代法杖减耗与升级。
localized.en_us: Vis Shard foci gain a survival research and crafting route after Shock, using TC4 wand discounts and upgrades.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 锚钩适配四代：使用法杖魔力与核心升级；锚定方块消失时断开牵引。
localized.en_us: Grapples use TC4 wand vis and focus upgrades, detaching when their anchor block disappears.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 建筑核心扣费已修正：只为成功放置的方块支付一次魔力。容器、多方块和受保护位置不会被直接覆盖。
localized.en_us: Builder foci charge once for each successful placement. Containers, multi-block structures and protected positions are not overwritten.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 屈光仪已改为节点测绘：显示13×13区块内、全高度的四代节点；可按碎片筛选并旋转、缩放查看。未加载区块只读取已有存档。
localized.en_us: The Dioptra surveys TC4 nodes across 13×13 chunks and the full build height. Filter with shards, rotate and zoom; unloaded chunks are read from existing saves.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 奥术组装器新增自定义布局：持杖连续设置九格，普通点击启用、潜行点击禁用；第九次统一提交，编辑期间暂停合成。
localized.en_us: Pattern Crafters add custom grids: set nine cells with a wand, ordinary click to enable and sneak-click to disable. The ninth click commits the layout; crafting pauses while editing.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 奥术组装器输出已修正：同时预留产物和容器返还物的空间，避免共用空槽导致丢失。
localized.en_us: Pattern Crafters reserve output space for both products and container remainders, preventing them from competing for the same empty slot.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 自动十字弩适配新版：可用药箭、光灵箭及其他现代箭矢，命中时也保护主人、友方并遵守PvP设置。
localized.en_us: Automated Crossbows accept tipped, spectral and other modern arrows. Impacts protect owners and allies and respect server PvP rules.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 自动十字弩配方适配四代：发条心智改为空白傀儡核心；缺少黄铜齿轮时使用炼金黄铜锭。
localized.en_us: Crossbow recipes replace Clockwork Minds with blank golem cores, and use alchemical brass ingots when brass gears are unavailable.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 碎片培育已改用四代节点：在对应蕴魔矿上种植，消耗附近节点的魔力生长；低储量时衰退返还魔力，保留最后的孤立种晶。
localized.en_us: Crystal cultivation uses TC4 nodes: plant on matching infused ore, consume nearby node vis to grow, and return vis when shrinking. The last isolated seed survives.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 无尽之瓮新增魔力加速：1 cv/t水魔力使产水和供水加快100倍；储存与目标均满时不扣费。
localized.en_us: Everfull Urns gain vis boosting: 1 cv/t Aqua increases water generation and delivery by 100×, spending nothing when the urn and recipients are full.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 虚空预言者适配四代：永久扭曲提供法杖魔力减耗，最高10%；多颗珍珠不叠加。
localized.en_us: Voidseer Pearls convert permanent warp into TC4 wand vis discounts, up to 10%, without stacking multiple pearls.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 悖论物质当前仅保留碰撞爆炸，没有六代的后续持续效果。
localized.en_us: Paradox Matter currently retains only its impact explosion, without TC6’s subsequent persistent effects.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 天象观测适配四代研究：首次观察及阅读笔记奖励要素研究点，不产生六代观察或理论知识；观察必须带纸。
localized.en_us: Celestial observations and notes reward TC4 aspect research points instead of TC6 observation or theory knowledge. Observing requires paper.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 珍品奖励适配四代：每种珍品给予三种要素各1–8点研究点，包含一种特有的元始要素。
localized.en_us: Curiosities reward 1–8 TC4 research points in each of three aspects, including a distinct primal aspect.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 荒古祭坛适配四代：周期缩短10%、不稳定性+1；祭坛与基座提供名义减耗，超过10%后递减，最高40%。
localized.en_us: Ancient altars use TC4 rules: 10% shorter cycles and +1 instability. Altar and pedestal discounts diminish above 10%, capped at 40%.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 邪术祭坛适配四代：周期缩短30%、源质消耗+5%、不稳定性−2；每个基座消耗+0.25%，每对对称基座提供1稳定性。
localized.en_us: Eldritch altars use TC4 rules: 30% shorter cycles, +5% essentia cost and −2 instability. Each pedestal adds 0.25% cost; each symmetric pair adds 1 stability.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 调节石适配四代：加速石每块周期−10%、消耗+1%；效能石周期+10%、名义减耗2%，共同遵守40%减耗上限。
localized.en_us: Regulators use TC4 rules: each speed stone gives −10% cycle time and +1% cost; each efficiency stone gives +10% time and 2% nominal discount, within the shared 40% cap.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 精炼源质适配四代：两种炼金炉支持十个蒸馏器，粘浆泵可为各类炼金炉扩展蒸馏列。
localized.en_us: Refined alchemy supports ten alembics per furnace; auxiliary pumps add alembic columns to alchemical furnaces.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 保命饰物适配新版：使用Curios饰品槽；不死护符消耗后恢复1点生命，并给予恢复与伤害吸收。
localized.en_us: Protective charms use Curios slots. The Charm of Undying is consumed to restore one health with regeneration and absorption.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 奥术合成背包适配新版：由精妙背包升级提供九格合成和真实法杖槽，材料、魔力与容器返还物按工作台规则结算。
localized.en_us: Arcane backpack crafting uses a Sophisticated Backpacks upgrade with nine cells and a real wand slot, following workbench rules for ingredients, vis and remainders.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 神秘机器接口适配新版：接入Modular Machinery Reborn，提供16级源质与魔力输入、输出端口；魔力以厘点计量。
localized.en_us: Thaumic machine interfaces target Modular Machinery Reborn, with sixteen tiers of essentia and centivis input/output ports.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 神秘养蜂适配新版：旧Magic Bees神秘蜂种与谱系接入现代Forestry及Mo’Bees，节点效果使用四代永久节点状态。
localized.en_us: Legacy Magic Bees thaumic species and breeding use modern Forestry and Mo’Bees, with node effects applied to permanent TC4 node state.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 空岛路线适配新版：旧Ex Astris神秘内容改用Ex Deorum的锤、筛网、桶与热源系统。
localized.en_us: Legacy Ex Astris thaumic progression uses Ex Deorum hammers, meshes, barrels and heat sources.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自未来的修改：六代染色闪耀之光也可为坩埚供热。
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures integration: TC6 colored nitor also heats crucibles.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自未来的修改：辅助粘浆泵可为本体炼金炉扩展蒸馏列。
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures integration: auxiliary slurry pumps add alembic columns to core alchemical furnaces.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自工业先锋的联动：采收器可处理成熟魔豆、水银花、烈焰花和魔菇，保留魔豆要素及保护检查。
localized.en_us: Industrial Foregoing integration: harvesters handle mature mana beans, shimmerleaf, cinderpearl and vishrooms, preserving bean aspects and protection checks.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自沉浸工程的联动：外部加热器可加热炼金炉，费用采用宿主熔炉默认值。
localized.en_us: Immersive Engineering integration: external heaters heat alchemical furnaces at the host’s default furnace energy cost.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自沉浸工程的联动：化学喷射器可喷射死亡之水，造成4点溶解伤害。
localized.en_us: Immersive Engineering integration: chemthrowers spray Liquid Death for 4 dissolution damage.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自沉浸工程的联动：喷射净化浴液提供100刻扭曲守护。
localized.en_us: Immersive Engineering integration: sprayed purifying fluid grants 100 ticks of Warp Ward.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自潘马斯的联动：收获傀儡可处理HarvestCraft 2作物及果树。
localized.en_us: Pam’s integration: harvest golems support HarvestCraft 2 crops and fruit trees.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自植物魔法的联动：现代Botania饰品通过Curios接入符文护盾。
localized.en_us: Botania integration: modern Botania accessories contribute runic shielding through Curios.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自植物魔法的联动：魔力钢、泰拉钢和源质钢揭示头盔接入节点与设备信息显示。
localized.en_us: Botania integration: manasteel, terrasteel and elementium revealing helmets show node and device information.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘时代：未来
localized.en_us: Thaumic Futures

localized.zh_cn: 来自匠魂的联动：神秘金属材料及额外强化槽接入TConstruct 3。
localized.en_us: Tinkers’ integration: thaumium material and extra modifier slots use TConstruct 3.
